title: 2026-10-02 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Efficient Expert-Parallel Communication on PCIe-Connected Consumer GPUs (Seoul National University, PCIe 消费级多卡上的 MoE 专家并行通信，dispatch/combine 相对 NCCL 快 2.00×/1.53×)、HAPMoE: Heterogeneity-Aware Automatic Parallelism Planning for Mixture-of-Experts Models Training (Peking University / Infinigence AI, MoE 训练自动并行：六维搜索 + 非均匀流水线切分，吞吐最高 3.2×)、Preserving Provenance in Shared KV Caches for LLM Serving (Macquarie University / NUS, 共享 KV cache 只按 token 取键会丢来源信息，跨 adapter 复用把准确率从 0.94 打到 0.64) 等
